instruction.name: vsrlri.b
instruction.description: Logical right shift of b elements by an immediate, setting the rounding bit.

latencies.notes: vj -> vd; consecutive unrolled copies form a chain.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vsrlri.b $vr0, $vr8, 1; vsrlri.b $vr1, $vr9, 1; vsrlri.b $vr2, $vr10, 1; vsrlri.b $vr3, $vr11, 1; vsrlri.b $vr4, $vr12, 1; vsrlri.b $vr5, $vr13, 1; vsrlri.b $vr6, $vr14, 1; vsrlri.b $vr7, $vr15, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.d $vr1, $r4; vreplgr2vr.d $vr2, $r4' --asm 'vsrlri.b $vr0, $vr8, 1; vsrlri.b $vr1, $vr9, 1; vsrlri.b $vr2, $vr10, 1; vsrlri.b $vr3, $vr11, 1; vsrlri.b $vr4, $vr12, 1; vsrlri.b $vr5, $vr13, 1; vsrlri.b $vr6, $vr14, 1; vsrlri.b $vr7, $vr15, 1'
